text: Added immutable PlotLabels with fluent title/subtitle/x-y helpers; GuideSpec.Axis titles default from derived scale names and accept overrides; PlotLayoutSolver now sizes axis-title strips and title/subtitle frames via TextMetrics; compiler lowers all labels to shared text grobs. Titled-plot conformance passes every backend. Verified graphics JVM+JS 123/123, SVG JVM 24/24 and JS 21/21, Canvas 6/6, Java2D 7/7, JavaFX 7/7.
